# Golden fixtures

Generated by `packages/core/scripts/fixtures.ts`; do not edit. Run `pnpm --filter @0xdolan/deq-core fixtures` after changing a shape or the renderer.

Each case in `manifest.json` gives a shape (or a composition) and render options. The SVG in `file` is the exact output of `@0xdolan/deq-core`, compared byte for byte. Every renderer (TypeScript, Python, Rust) must reproduce every file. The output contract is in [ADR 0008](../../docs/decisions/0008-core-renderer-and-golden-fixtures.md).

- `shapes/`: every shape with default parameters and options.
- `params/`: integer parameters at their minimum and maximum, and every other enum or boolean value.
- `options/`: each render option.
- `compose/`: compositions.
